description: A concise continuous terminal replay of discovery, delivery and customer handoff. Fictional customers; real local code and tests; no production deployment.

scenes.label: 01/07  Discover
scenes.prompt: @fde Finance sees duplicate payment retries. What do we know?
scenes.answer:
A hypothesis, not a measured incident.
Trace one failed payment with Finance.
Measure the recovery work before designing the fix.

scenes.label: 02/07  Scope
scenes.answer:
PAY-42: one write per tenant and event.
No ledger redesign.
Acceptance: seven checks, then customer staging.
scenes.activity: plan | defining the slice and acceptance

scenes.label: 03/07  Build
scenes.prompt: @fde Build it. Save my place before the call.
scenes.answer:
retry.js changed: validate identity and deduplicate.
Checkpoint saved.
Next: run the full local suite.

scenes.label: 04/07  Switch customer
scenes.prompt: @fde Kesterman meeting in five minutes. Brief me.
scenes.answer:
Denise must choose: defer Nashville views,
or trade scope for the timeline.
Garvey’s unfinished work is preserved.

scenes.label: 05/07  Resume and test
scenes.answer:
Checkpoint recovered.
7/7 local tests pass.
The customer receiver still needs staging verification.
scenes.activity: build + verify | resuming the exact next action

scenes.label: 06/07  Rollout decision
scenes.answer:
Not yet. Replay against the durable receiver
on customer staging. Security, CTO approval
and Finance acceptance are still pending.

scenes.label: 07/07  Handover
scenes.prompt: @fde Prepare handover and leave the next step.
scenes.answer:
Runbook draft ready: owner, rollback and staging checks.
Saved next action: arrange the authorised replay.
scenes.activity: handoff | leaving the customer able to continue
